limitations: The org.modkitx.sc2/galaxy-pure-bounded-v1 profile executes only zero-argument Galaxy functions composed from direct calls and literal returns.
External/native calls are reported as native-unavailable; Trigger XML is retained as native authored input but semantic lowering is unavailable.
Catalog mechanics, Galaxy control flow and expressions, save/replay/network behavior, native launch/signing/playback, and the Block 19 simulator migration remain unavailable.
